hint: tap anywhere to pass the bread

game.q: why give thanks when the food isn’t even enough?
opts: “even a little bread was already God’s gift”

wrong.hangry: they were hungry. that’s not why he gave thanks.
wrong.manners: polite, sure. but it meant more than manners.

game.right: YES. the thanks first, then the plenty. the gift was already in a boy’s small basket.

end.line: five loaves, thousands of people, and the thanks came first.
end.l2: he gave thanks before it was enough.
